title: When the backlog drain ends, compare every roadmap step not done against main and merged PRs
why: Owner 12:51 CST Nov 13 (relayed by the retrospective): after all the drains occur, check the roadmap against what has landed, so nothing reads pending that has landed.
source: owner 12:51 CST Nov 13, relayed by the retrospective
note: Todo, starts when the backlog drain ends. A Sonnet read compares every roadmap step not marked done against main and merged PRs, and marks done each one that landed, with the commit. Example seen Nov 13: step mcp-merge-unguarded read ready, but 625a87260 landed it Nov 10. The retrospective carries it in its handoff and reports the count. Closes only from a commit read, never in bulk (ledger step bulk-close-needs-ledger).
